title: zanthoxylum avicennae
intro: Zanthoxylum avicennae, commonly known as Persian prickly ash, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant effects, offering several health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum avicennae include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and limonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
